create_UIManager: create a UIManager instance to manage UI canvases for multiple users in a HITL simulation
update_canvas_with_UIContext: use UIManager update_canvas as a context manager to add UI elements to a named canvas
create_label_with_UIContext: create a text label on a UI canvas with configurable font size, bold, and alignment
create_button_with_UIContext: create a clickable button on a UI canvas and check if it was pressed with is_button_pressed
create_toggle_with_UIContext: create a toggle button with true and false labels and an optional tooltip on a UI canvas
